# This vs. That

> A comprehensive comparison resource covering technology, language, and business differences across diverse topics.

This vs. That provides side-by-side comparisons of commonly confused terms, products, and concepts. The site covers file formats and software (particularly Microsoft PowerPoint), search engines, and English language usage to help users understand key distinctions.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft PowerPoint
- File formats
- PPT vs PPTX
- XML
- Search engines
- Google
- Yandex
- English grammar
- Phrasal verbs
- Linguistic differences
- Compatibility
- Presentation software
- Market share analysis
- Usage guide
- File extensions

## Technology & File Formats

- [PPT vs. PPTX - What's the Difference?](https://thisvsthat.io/ppt-vs-pptx): Comparison of PPT and PPTX file formats for Microsoft PowerPoint presentations

## Search Engines & Web Services

- [Google vs. Yandex - What's the Difference?](https://thisvsthat.io/google-vs-yandex): Comparison of Google and Yandex search engines with market and regional analysis

## English Language & Grammar

- [Start Doing vs. Start to Do - What's the Difference?](https://thisvsthat.io/start-doing-vs-start-to-do): English grammar guide comparing phrasal verb usage: start doing vs start to do
- [Variation vs. Variety - What's the Difference?](https://thisvsthat.io/variation-vs-variety): Linguistic comparison of variation and variety definitions and usage differences
